description: Duplicate one or more scene objects, with everything attached under them. Each copy keeps the pose, outfit, transform, colours and third-party plugin data of its source, and lands under the same parent. Studio allocates fresh ids, so the result pairs each copy with the 'source_id' it came from. Route points and the fixed sub-nodes of a character or a route cannot be duplicated on their own and are refused. Not undoable. Note that plugin data restored on the copies (node constraints in particular) lands a few frames later, so re-read it rather than querying it in the same batch.

id.description: id of the object to duplicate, or an array of ids to duplicate in one go, from studio_list_objects

output.description: { count, objects } where each entry is 'source_id' plus one entry of studio_list_objects describing the copy
